verdicts.note: Judges' safety may rest only on bail, diversion or professional-formation evidence; endorsements are outside that list. On those grounds the record is mixed. His formation is part prosecution (Cheney municipal prosecutor; a WAPA program that was child-support enforcement, a civil function) and part private family, juvenile, criminal and immigration practice [S5]. He backs therapeutic courts and solutions that address root causes like addiction and mental health, while keeping accountability [S2]. No bail position. Valerien (Pos. 2) has a heavier prosecution formation (eight years as an assistant city prosecutor) and similar therapeutic-court support, and is scored 0. Consistency puts Addams at 0 too.
